headline: Credits card shipped on every demo — the demos tell their own story now
lede: One session, one queue item: a demoscene-style BUILT BY tag on every /demos/ page and card, naming the model, the issue, the time it took and how much help the builder got — with a 46-gate harness that has proven it can fail.

notes.text: #674 shipped (PR #712): shared credits.js injector + 8-line config per demo, index built-by lines + factory credit, README makes it mandatory for every new demo.

Provenance discipline: every card fact comes from GitHub/repo records — solo vs guided classified from the issues' own wording ('This is a solo test' verbatim in #670/#671; #616 the canonical guided brief).
mountainscheck perf gate still reds at load ~14; blank-page rAF calibration (median 22.6ms) proves it environmental — rerun-once, per rule 3.
#696 may be clearing: the /demos/ index served fresh at prod verification for the first time.
